rationale: The frozen kernel contract is BEHAVIOR ONLY: the CLI verbs/flags, the awa-worktree/v1 dashboard JSON shape, the guard permission schema, and the .awa/lease.json shape. These surfaces are the kernel's public interface; the engine may only BACK them, never silently change them. Removing/renaming a required verb/flag/key, or changing a schema string, is a breaking change that requires a versioned bump (awa-contract.v2.json). Additive, backward-compatible fields (new OPTIONAL keys) are allowed WITHIN v1. FILE LOCATIONS ARE NOT FROZEN: the shim/hook/emitter paths recorded below are informational and resolved by ROLE (AWA_HOME / the installed release path / a host overlay), because location was never the interface. Re-homing the generic kernel from a host's _ops/ into KleinPerkins/awa/kernel/ therefore needs NO contract bump (D-CONTRACT). The in-repo role-resolved freeze checker (kernel/checks/awa-contract-freeze.sh) enforces the behavior floor against the live shims wherever they are installed.

informational.note: NOT part of the frozen interface. These record where the reference implementation ships inside KleinPerkins/awa; hosts/installs MAY relocate them. The freeze checker resolves the live shims BY ROLE (AWA_HOME or the installed path), never by these literals.

cli.tool_note: INFORMATIONAL — reference-impl location, NOT frozen. Resolved by role (AWA_HOME/kernel/bin/dev-worktree.sh or the installed release). Only the verbs + flags below are frozen behavior.

dashboard_data.additive_note: The Phase-0/8 dashboard (X4) MAY add OPTIONAL top-level/summary keys (e.g. promise-state, scope, degraded, stale) additively without a version bump; the required key sets above are the immutable floor.

guard_permission.hook_note: INFORMATIONAL — reference-impl location, NOT frozen. Resolved by role (AWA_HOME/kernel/hooks/worktree-guard.sh or the installed release). Only the permission schema below is frozen behavior.
guard_permission.note: beforeShellExecution is the ONE honored pre-mutation gate (ask/deny block). afterFileEdit is observation-only: the guard MUST return allow there and MUST NOT emit a no-op ask (X2).

lease.identity_rule: lease_id = hash(worktree_path + branch + git_common_dir + boot_id). NEVER a bare pid (a pid is reused across reboots/processes). pid MAY be recorded as an informational field but is never the identity.
lease.collision_boundary: The per-git_common_dir advisory lock (git rev-parse --git-common-dir) is the real collision boundary; branch/path uniqueness is necessary but not sufficient.
lease.wal_placement: SQLite state.db and its -wal/-shm sidecars MUST live under ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/awa on local disk, never a cloud-synced/network path.
lease.note: No component emits a lease yet (recovery/engine unbuilt). This shape is the FORWARD contract the kernel/engine must back when leases land (Phase 2). awa-contract-freeze.sh validates any lease file that DOES exist against this shape.
